skins.name: An Airy Dream
skins.description: Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.

skins.name: In A Myriad of Universes
skins.code: Test Collection Series/In A Myriad of Universes
skins.description: A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.

skins.name: Quiet Move
skins.description: He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.
